direction: Whole familiar laughing kookaburra, lathe-shaped ovoids/spindles/half-shell components, coarse curved parting grooves and circular endgrain, natural wood fields. Lozenge clock echoes off-axis turned silhouettes, pin marks lathe center holes, baton hands tool-rest lines. Basin charge recalls a turned hollow bowl cross-section, band calendar short parting lines. Compact companion is only three short nested quarter-turn arcs plus one small tenon shoulder; no whole bird, full turned bowl/medallion, woodlath lattice, compass dial or enclosing rings. Retain shipped calendar/date/highlight/identity outlines; no date-containment design gate.
